# Facts where llrm-qb still differs from BC; see the test's report.

# CURRENCY: llrm-qb has no CURRENCY type.
vbdos CUE refused
vbdos CALLALL call __AFCYLD #1 stack
vbdos CALLALL call __AFCYLD #1 cleanup
vbdos CALLALL call __AFCYST #1 stack
vbdos CALLALL call __AFCYST #1 cleanup
vbdos CALLALL call PCUR #1 stack
vbdos CALLALL call PCUR #1 cleanup
vbdos CALLALL call PUTY #1 stack
vbdos CALLALL call PUTY #1 cleanup
vbdos CALLALL call RCUR #1 stack
vbdos CALLALL call RCUR #1 cleanup
vbdos CALLALL call PUTY #2 stack
vbdos CALLALL call PUTY #2 cleanup
pds71 CUE refused
pds71 CALLALL call __AFCYLD #1 stack
pds71 CALLALL call __AFCYLD #1 cleanup
pds71 CALLALL call __AFCYST #1 stack
pds71 CALLALL call __AFCYST #1 cleanup
pds71 CALLALL call PCUR #1 stack
pds71 CALLALL call PCUR #1 cleanup
pds71 CALLALL call PUTY #1 stack
pds71 CALLALL call PUTY #1 cleanup
pds71 CALLALL call RCUR #1 stack
pds71 CALLALL call RCUR #1 cleanup
pds71 CALLALL call PUTY #2 stack
pds71 CALLALL call PUTY #2 cleanup

# SEG in a SUB definition: BC's definition takes a near pointer (RETF 6)
# while its own callers push a far one, so BC's program fails. llrm-qb
# keeps the far pointer its callers and BC's push.
vbdos PSEGD return
vbdos PSEGD call PUTI #1 stack
vbdos PSEGD call PUTI #2 stack
pds71 PSEGD return
pds71 PSEGD call PUTI #1 stack
pds71 PSEGD call PUTI #2 stack
